label: GPT-6.1 Terra
output:
**To:** Bethan Rees  
**Subject:** Re: Nia’s hen - Tenby final plan + money!!

Hey Beth,

Just messaging you separately because I don’t want to get into it on the group.

I can understand why you don’t fancy a whole weekend in the cottage if you’re feeling uncomfortable. Things have been awkward since Lowri’s birthday, and I know you both said things. I’m not taking sides, honestly. I do think Lowri might be sorry about it really, but she’s as stubborn as you are!

Would you have a think about coming just for the Saturday? You could skip Friday and the paddleboarding, get the train from Cardiff Central and be in Tenby for about 6. It’s around two and a half hours, I think. I’ll pick you up from the station and you can come straight to the meal with us. I’ve got the twin room, so you can kip in with me Saturday night.

I swapped my Orlando trip with Kerry from work to get the weekend off, and gave up a night stop I really wanted, so you know how much I want us all there for Nia! She rang me crying last week asking if you were still coming. She doesn’t know you’ve pulled out yet.

You were there for her every night in the Heath when her mam was bad, Beth. She’ll never forget that. You’re doing a reading at her wedding at Margam on 17th April too, and you mean the world to her. I’d hate for you to miss the hen and regret it, and I think she’d really feel it if you weren’t there.

Anyway, no lecture from me, I promise. Just have a think before you decide for good. And hang on before sending Lowri any money – she’s said not to worry about it.

Love you,  
Siân xx
